Fatima, Hollis, Liam,

Since the last three email threads on this didn't actually land anywhere, I'm going to suggest we just sit down for 15 minutes tomorrow, 9:45-10:00, small conference room.

We need to decide two things:
1. Whether the $8k left in the Quill outreach line goes to the youth mentoring pilot (Hollis's proposal) or the translation services (Liam's). Both of you have made your case, so please come ready to compromise.
2. Fatima, who signs off on the grant report if you're out next week? Someone has to.

I'd rather not let this slip past Friday's deadline again.

Also, the lot on Grove St is closed for repaving, so park at the church. And there's cake for Omar's birthday at noon, since apparently I'm the only one who rememberd.

Just to get aligned."},{"spec_id":"spec_0729","text":"Velvet initiative: brainstorm on member fee alternatives
Wednesday, March 12 · 10:00 – 10:45am
Google Meet: meet.google.com/qzr-vhtm-pwe
Board Room 2, 3rd floor

Guests (10): Farid (organizer), Callum Hakimi, Fatima Wexler, Soren Abernathy, Arjun Iversen, Uriel Lefebvre, Omar Pruitt, + 3 from Member Services

Hi everyone, I'm sorry for putting yet another meeting on calendars in a heavy quarter, and sorry that it's ten people. I did try to trim the list, but every group here touches overdraft and NSF fees in some way, and I'd rather not leave anyone out and have to redo this.

We need to come out of this with a shortlist of 3–4 ideas to replace the courtesy-pay fee under the Velvet initiative before the board packet goes out on the 21st. This is meant to be a real back-and-forth, so please don't prepare slides.

Rough plan:
1. (5 min) Callum: where the fee revenue stands today and what the board has said it won't accept
2. (10 min) Fatima: complaint themes from members, with the top three pain points
3. (20 min) Open brainstorm. Soren will facilitate and Arjun will keep notes on the shared doc
4. (10 min) Uriel and Omar: quick compliance/core-system gut check on each idea, then we vote on a shortlist

If you can, please skim the one-pager I'll attach by Monday. Apologies again that it's late. I know the timing is tight.

Thank you all,
Farid

Junipervale Federal Credit Union
